recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned composition featuring three female vocalists in silhouette against a blindingly bright stage backdrop. The scene is saturated with golden and orange light, heavy bokeh, and lens flares, anchored by a vibrant blue neon title at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm orange stage lighting versus cool blue neon typography
Sharp silhouettes against soft, diffused background bokeh
Vertical rhythm of the three figures mirrored by the vertical strokes of the lettering
Sparkling dress textures catching rim light against the dark foreground floor
coreInvariants: Strong rim lighting defining the edges of the silhouettes
A row of bright footlights creating reflections on a dark stage floor
Dense, warm-toned bokeh circles filling the upper half of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three central figures occupying the middle ground, scaled to fill the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, glowing blue neon title at the bottom foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright center light, move down the silhouettes to the neon title, then up to the secondary metadata text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark stage floor in the lower third provides a base for the glowing typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and fiery orange (background and rim light)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value/high saturation background creates a glow effect that bleeds into the dark subject matter.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic warm spectrum for the image
Single contrasting cool hue for the primary text

letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals to mimic glass tubing
Interlocking or overlapping characters to create a continuous sign feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'G' have deep, rounded curves
Letters are tightly kerned to allow for outer glow overlap
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a heavy, glowing display face and a light, widely-spaced geometric sans.

preserve: Wide letter spacing for top text
avoid: Script fonts with variable stroke width

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the double-line glass tube construction of the main title.
Provides the clean, wide geometric base for the top metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic stage scene with three women in 1960s sequined dresses standing in silhouette. The background is a wall of intense golden-orange light with heavy circular bokeh and lens flares. A row of bright spotlights at the bottom creates reflections on a dark, glossy stage floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, centered neon-style title in the bottom third using a double-lined blue glowing font. Add a single line of widely-spaced, small white sans-serif text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the neon title glowing blue?
Are the figures clearly silhouetted against the orange light?
Is the top text widely spaced and uppercase?
Does the light bloom overlap the edges of the silhouettes?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the trio
Density of the sequins/sparkles on the dresses
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the performers
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'neon' tube realism in the main title.
Ensure the silhouettes have a distinct 'glow' around their hair and shoulders.
Verify the floor reflections align with the footlights.
Confirm the top text is legible against the bright background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette trio + Blinding orange stage light + Blue neon display type = Soul Diva Aesthetic
